heuristic.justification: ProfileRiskCalculator documents a 0-100 score where higher values represent greater concern.
limitations: Heuristic profile risk is supporting evidence only, not suicide probability.

machine_learning.justification: Phase 4D verified the active profile model probability as the yes depression class.
limitations: Depression-class probability is supporting risk evidence, not suicide probability.

dass21.justification: The canonical DASS-21 prediction stores total DASS-21 score normalized from the 126 maximum into a 0-100 engineering screening score.
limitations: DASS-21 scoring itself is unchanged and is not a suicide-risk diagnosis.

mood.justification: DailyCheckInCalculator documents a 0-100 score where higher values represent greater concern; no inversion is needed.
limitations: Mood/check-in heuristic is short-term screening support only.

text.justification: Phase 4D verified the active text model probability as the suicidal class probability.
limitations: Classifier output is not a calibrated clinical suicide probability.
SafeTalk intent output is not used as text modality evidence.

speech.justification: Phase 4K permits speech only after runtime verification, consent, freshness, and fusion eligibility pass.
limitations: Voice-emotion output is supporting screening evidence only, not suicidal intent.

face.justification: Phase 4K permits face only after runtime verification, explicit consent, freshness, reliability approval, and fusion eligibility pass.
limitations: Facial-emotion output is experimental support only unless separately approved; it is not a diagnosis.
